note: PERSONALITY / VOICE database — who each character IS and how they TALK (their canon Total Drama / Ridonculous Race / Disventure Camp personality), independent of any single season's run. This is the definitive guide to a character's dialogue and behavior; use it so no character drifts into a generic archetype. (Season-specific run history / deeds are handled separately by the franchise context.)

profiles.Alejandro: 26, Hispanic Spanish-Canadian, The Arch Villain. Smooth, charming, calculated manipulator. Weaponizes charm and good looks, always three steps ahead, never lets you see the scheme. Silky, flattering speech that hides a knife.
profiles.Amy: Cruel, vain mean-girl twin. Bossy and entitled, belittles her sister Samey, takes credit and shifts blame. Sharp, dismissive put-downs.
profiles.Anne Maria: Jersey-tough, tan-obsessed diva. Sprays tanner constantly, brash and unbothered, tough-talking with a thick accent. Refuses to break a nail.
profiles.Axel: Tough, no-nonsense outdoorswoman. Blunt, action-first, zero patience for drama or whining. Says little, does a lot.
profiles.B: Silent inventor genius. Never speaks — communicates through gestures and brilliant gadgets. Calm, clever, unflappable.
profiles.Beardo: Shy sound-effects/beatbox guy. Barely talks; reacts with human sound effects instead of words. Awkward but good-natured.
profiles.Beth: Eager, sweet, geeky wannabe. Tries too hard, loyal follower, insecure but genuinely kind. Gushes and over-shares.
profiles.Blaineley: Vain, cutthroat gossip-TV host. Self-absorbed, dramatic, will burn anyone for fame and airtime. Smug and theatrical.
profiles.Bowie: 22, gay. Sweet, dramatic theater kid. Expressive, supportive, non-confrontational; devoted to his friends. Emotes big.
profiles.Brick: Honorable military cadet. Disciplined, calls people by rank, loyal to a fault, courageous — but crumbles under pressure (and has a weak bladder). Earnest, formal speech.
profiles.Bridgette: Sunny, surfer-calm peacemaker. 'You guys,' smooths over tension and apologizes for other people; gets flustered and awkward when forced to play cutthroat.
profiles.Brightly: A brilliant aspiring scientist stuck working at a daycare to pay her tuition. Sharp, analytical and strategic — but sometimes misses social context clues, or the emotional read, when she over-analyzes a situation. Talks like she's reasoning through a problem out loud; book-smart and occasionally people-blind.
profiles.Brody: Chill, dim, enthusiastic surfer bro. Loyal and warm, easily excited, devoted to his best friend Geoff. Goofy, upbeat, not the sharpest.
profiles.Caleb: Eager and over-explaining; apologizes reflexively, name-drops whoever told him what, talks fast when nervous and walks back his own points mid-sentence. Charming when relaxed, a fumbling mess the second he's cornered.
profiles.Cameron: Sheltered bubble-boy genius. Nervous, over-analytical, physically frail, book-smart but socially green. Rambles about science when anxious.
profiles.Carrie: Kind, warm, indecisive nice girl. Emotionally tangled up over her best friend Devin; avoids conflict, second-guesses herself.
profiles.Chase: Quiet, smooth, easygoing — dangerous precisely because people underestimate him. Understated, keeps his real game hidden. 'Trust gets you voted out.'
profiles.Chef Hatchet: Gruff ex-military cook. Barks orders, disgusted by everything, intimidating; three words max, with a rare hidden soft spot.
profiles.Chet: Whiny, competitive bickering stepbrother. Squabbles endlessly with Lorenzo over nothing, petty and dramatic.
profiles.Chris McLean: Sadistic narcissist host. Genuinely delighted by contestant suffering, vain about his looks, lazy, easily distracted. Mean without a wink.
profiles.Cody: Try-hard geek charmer. Awkward but plucky, self-aware about his failures and goes for it anyway; harmless flirt.
profiles.Courtney: Controlling, type-A ex-CIT. Sharp commands, obsessed with rules and being right, furious when ignored or underestimated. Bossy and combative.
profiles.Crimson: bi. bi. Deadpan goth. Monotone, dark, unbothered; speaks in flat morbid observations, inseparable from Ennui.
profiles.Dakota: Fame-obsessed rich girl. Loves paparazzi and attention, spoiled and shallow on the surface but sweetens over time.
profiles.Damien: Quiet and sparing cerebral strategist. Rations his words, deflects with one flat joke instead of arguing, never tips his hand; the more cornered he is, the calmer he gets.
profiles.Dave: Neurotic germaphobe. Anxious, sarcastic, easily disgusted, obsessive over cleanliness and over romance. Spirals fast.
profiles.Dawn: Soft, mystical, unsettlingly perceptive. Reads auras, speaks in gentle cryptic observations, delivers hard truths without a trace of malice.
profiles.Devin: Earnest, kind nice-guy racer. Overly hung up on his ex, agreeable, tries to keep everyone happy. Sincere and a bit oblivious.
profiles.DJ: 25, Black Canadian Jamaican. Gentle giant, sweet mama's boy. Soft-hearted, loves animals, cries easily, morally uncomfortable with mean play. Warm and polite.
profiles.Duncan: Delinquent bad boy. Tough, sarcastic, loves stirring trouble and scaring people; secretly softer than he lets on. Smug, blunt.
profiles.Dwayne: Dorky, embarrassing dad. Well-meaning and hopelessly uncool, over-competitive on his son Junior's behalf, gives cringe pep talks. Earnest and clueless.
profiles.Ella: Disney-princess singer. Sings constantly, relentlessly cheerful and kind, talks to animals, refuses to be anything but sweet.
profiles.Ellody: Over-analytical genius. Logical, science-minded, buries everything in jargon and hypotheses; struggles with the human factor.
profiles.Emma: Uptight, type-A overachiever. Lawyer-track, rigid and driven, loosens up around Noah. Clipped and no-nonsense.
profiles.Emmah: Scrappy, sharp-tongued, underestimated and furious about it. Turns information into weapons, all swagger. 'Written off again. Watch what I do with that.'
profiles.Ennui: Monotone goth. Deadpan, unbothered by anything, flat morbid one-liners; devoted to Crimson without ever showing it.
profiles.Eva: LOUD and explosive, zero filter. SHOUTS and storms off, denies she's angry in the middle of yelling; blunt to the point of being funny. Pure muscle, short fuse.
profiles.Ezekiel: Earnest, awkward, old-school homeschool kid trying to prove he's grown. The verbal tic 'eh,' socially a step behind but genuinely trying.
profiles.Geoff: Laid-back party bro. Friendly and warm, loves parties, hosts everything, devoted to Bridgette. Easygoing 'dude' energy.
profiles.Gerry: Needling, sarcastic old-timer. Pokes people just to watch them flinch, plays dumb and then twists the knife, grumbles about everything and loves being underestimated.
profiles.Gwen: bi. bi. Deadpan, sarcastic goth. Tired of everyone and everything, dry wit, genuine fierce loyalty to the few she trusts.
profiles.Harold: Nerdy know-it-all. Dorky over-confidence, brags about his 'mad skills,' dramatic and easily wounded, weirdly competent at random things.
profiles.Heather: The manipulative queen-bee villain. Cruel, status-obsessed, openly strategic; sweet only when she wants something, sharp condescending put-downs otherwise. Respects only competence.
profiles.Hicks: The Southern Observer — the most emotionally intelligent person in any room. Reads people's real motives instantly, quiet and deliberate, chooses words like he's paying for them. Trusts loyalty over cold logic.
profiles.Izzy: Unhinged, chaotic wildcard. Manic energy, wild non-sequitur stories, unpredictable and fearless, genuinely a little dangerous — and having the time of her life.
profiles.Jacques: gay. Theatrical ex-figure-skater ego. Dramatic, image-obsessed, a fallen champion with something to prove; grand declarations, then cold calculation.
profiles.Jasmine: Blunt Australian outdoorswoman. No-nonsense, capable, protective of the people she trusts, calls out nonsense directly. Tall-and-tough presence.
profiles.Jay: Shy, timid twin. Anxious and sweet, defers to his brother Mickey, apologizes constantly, terrified of everything.
profiles.Jen: Warm, perceptive social manager. Reads the room and keeps the peace while quietly positioning herself. Upbeat but always counting.
profiles.Jo: Aggressive jock. Drill-sergeant energy, dominating and ruthless, treats everything as a contest to win. Barks, taunts, mocks the weak.
profiles.Josee: Olympic-level competitive figure skater. Full tantrum mode when she loses, surface sweetness that cracks under pressure into pure venom.
profiles.Julia: 21, White Canadian, The Influencer and Evil in Human Form. Sweet-poison manipulator. Disarms you with a smile and then cuts, talks people into their own bad decisions; no loyalty and won't bother pretending otherwise once she's caught.
profiles.Junior: Mature-beyond-his-years kid racer. Wants independence from his embarrassing dad Dwayne, level-headed, quietly exasperated.
profiles.Justin: Vain male model. Obsessed with his own looks, shallow, expects everything handed to him for being pretty. Coasts on charm.
profiles.Katie: Boy-crazy, sweet BFF. Inseparable from Sadie, ditzy and giggly, finishes Sadie's sentences, falls apart when they're separated.
profiles.Kelly: Mild, folksy strategist hiding in plain sight. Downplays her game, disarms people with total normalcy, then quietly reveals she's three moves ahead.
profiles.Kitty: Bubbly, kind, selfie-loving racer. Social-media obsessed, warm and fun, devoted to her uptight sister Emma.
profiles.Laurie: Preachy eco-hippie. Vegan activist, calm and earnest until she's judging your carbon footprint; sanctimonious with Miles.
profiles.Leonard: Delusional LARPer 'wizard.' Genuinely believes he can cast spells, narrates fantasy nonsense, unshakably committed to the bit.
profiles.Leshawna: Sassy, loud, confident. Tells it exactly like it is, fiercely loyal, big personality and bigger opinions, zero tolerance for fakes.
profiles.Lightning: Cocky third-person jock. Talks about himself in third person ('Sha-Lightning!'), convinced he's the greatest athlete alive, oblivious and loud.
profiles.Lindsay: Ditzy, sweet blonde. Forgets everyone's names, endlessly kind and oblivious, easily led, secretly stronger than she seems.
profiles.Lorenzo: Lazy, sarcastic bickering stepbrother. Genuinely unbothered by almost everything, drops things on purpose, squabbles with Chet.
profiles.MacArthur: lesbian. Brash, loud cop. Barks orders, calls people 'genius' sarcastically, hyper-competitive about everything. 'I have depth — it's under the yelling.'
profiles.Mary: Monotone genius. Purely logical and scientific, flat affect, over-explains in jargon; brainy partner to Ellody.
profiles.Max: Wannabe cartoon supervillain. Declares himself 'EVIL!' constantly, theatrical and incompetent, foiled by his own schemes. Small man, big menace complex.
profiles.Mickey: Anxious, clumsy, accident-prone. Breathes fast under stress, always waiting for disaster, sweet and nervous; twin of Jay.
profiles.Mike: 24, Italian Canadian, Overly dedicated actor/comedian. Mike talks like someone trying to keep the peace while also hiding panic: cautious, apologetic, and quick to soften what he says. In arguments, he tends to dodge or explain rather than attack, unless someone he cares about is in danger. His vocabulary is earnest and teenager-casual, with nervous stalling when he is cornered and a warmer, more direct tone when he finally tells the truth.
profiles.Miles: Earnest eco-hippie activist. Vegan, environmentalist, gentle but preachy; partners with Laurie in judgment.
profiles.Millie: 20, Black American. High-strung eco-activist overachiever. Passionate about the environment and causes, intensely competitive and perfectionist, anxious and easily overwhelmed; lectures people about doing the right thing, spirals under pressure. Earnest, a little exhausting, genuinely good-hearted underneath the stress.
profiles.MK: queer. Stealthy, deadpan loner. Quiet, athletic, ninja-like; says little, watches everything, dry when she does speak.
profiles.Nichelle: Glamorous diva actress. Star attitude, dramatic, image-conscious, expects the spotlight; softer underneath the celebrity gloss.
profiles.Noah: Sarcastic, lazy bookworm. Deadpan and witty, uninterested in effort, cutting one-liners, secretly capable when he bothers.
profiles.Owen: bi. Lovable, food-obsessed goofball. Farts, eats everything, relentlessly friendly and optimistic, cries and hugs easily. The heart of any group.
profiles.Pete: One of the Tennis Rivals — a loud, cranky, ultra-competitive older tennis player locked in a lifelong rivalry with Gerry. They trash-talk and one-up each other nonstop but are secretly close friends. Stubborn, old-school, cannot stand losing, quick to gloat.
profiles.Priya: Chill, grounded, smart nice girl. Level-headed and kind, the calm voice of reason, quietly strategic without the drama.
profiles.Raj: gay. Sweet, gentle athlete. Supportive and easygoing, emotionally open, devoted to his boyfriend Bowie. Soft-spoken kindness.
profiles.Ripper: Loud, gross, dim-but-loyal human chaos. Non-sequiturs and dumb brags, loses his own train of thought, openly hates 'smart conversations,' and is occasionally, accidentally profound.
profiles.Rock: Chill, dim rocker bro. Air-guitars everything, laid-back and slow on the uptake, inseparable from Spud.
profiles.Rodney: Big, bashful country lug. Falls head-over-heels for every girl he meets and feels guilty about it, mixes up his words, gentle giant.
profiles.Ryan: Strong, loyal athlete boyfriend. Confident physically, kind of lost without his girlfriend Stephanie, not a subtle player.
profiles.Sadie: Sweet, boy-crazy BFF. Follows Katie everywhere, giggly and emotional, falls apart when separated from her.
profiles.Sam: Laid-back gamer. References video games constantly, sweet, easygoing slacker, means well and tries hard for the people he likes.
profiles.Samey: Sweet nice twin (Sammy). Overshadowed and bullied by her sister Amy, insecure but finds her backbone and stands up for herself.
profiles.Sanders: lesbian. Rule-following police cadet. Professional and by-the-book, genuinely uncomfortable with grey areas and dirty play; the responsible one.
profiles.Scarlett: Cold, clinical genius villain. Condescending-polite, lectures in precise vocabulary with zero warmth, treats other players as variables in a problem she's already solved.
profiles.Scary Girl: asexual. Horror-obsessed goth (that's literally what everyone calls her). Fixated on the macabre — death, doom, creepy trivia — delivered in a flat, unsettling deadpan; loves anything dark and morbid and stares a beat too long. Genuinely sweet and loyal under the spooky exterior, just wired for the creepy.
profiles.Scott: Scheming farm boy who plays dumb. Sneaky, likes stirring chaos from a distance, cocky and slippery; devious with a grin.
profiles.Shawn: Zombie-apocalypse survivalist. Paranoid conspiracy nut, always prepping for the end, distrusts everyone — except sweet, soft for Jasmine.
profiles.Sierra: Obsessive superfan stalker. Knows every fact about the show and contestants (especially Cody), overwhelming energy, no boundaries, means well.
profiles.Sky: Driven, focused athlete. Disciplined and kind, torn between competition and feelings (for Dave); earnest and competitive.
profiles.Spud: Dumb, chill rocker. Extremely slow on the uptake, half-asleep energy, mumbles, follows Rock's lead.
profiles.Staci: Compulsive chatterbox liar. Claims her ancestors invented literally everything, talks nonstop, harmless but exhausting.
profiles.Stephanie: Intense, volatile girlfriend. Passionate and driven, swings from loving to furious in a heartbeat, dominates her boyfriend Ryan.
profiles.Sugar: Crude, delusional pageant queen. Gross and mean, thinks she's glamorous, redneck manners, jealous and petty.
profiles.Tammy: A LARPer — Leonard's fellow live-action role-player. Fully committed to the fantasy bit: casts 'spells,' speaks in medieval sorceress role-play, treats every challenge like a quest. Delusional, earnest fun, unshakably in character.
profiles.Taylor: Spoiled rich brat. Entitled and demanding, obsessed with status, contemptuous of her mom Kelly, wants everything handed to her.
profiles.Tom: gay. Sweet, supportive, gentle. Loyal to his friends, doesn't scheme, speaks simply and honestly. Kind without being a pushover.
profiles.Topher: Chris-obsessed wannabe host. Vain and fame-hungry, mimics Chris, would sell out anyone for the spotlight and the hosting gig.
profiles.Trent: Earnest, mellow musician. 'Look, guys,' always trying to keep the peace; genuinely wounded when trust breaks and says so plainly instead of scheming.
profiles.Tyler: Clumsy, enthusiastic jock. Tries hard and fails spectacularly at sports, loud and eager, hopelessly devoted to Lindsay.
profiles.Wayne: Warm, goofy, hockey-brained, loyal. Blurts his feelings, insists he's 'fine' when he clearly isn't, says 'I've got your back' and means it. NOT the reboot 'Dwayne' and NOT a dad — no kids, no parental framing.
profiles.Zee: Easygoing, funny, meme-brained. Relaxed and social, cracks jokes, goes with the flow, likable and non-threatening.
profiles.Zoey: Steady, perceptive, kind. Hates conflict, cautious, rarely shows her hand; sweet indie girl who toughens up when pushed.
profiles.Thom: 29, White American, The Spy, gay. Tom tends to speak in a guarded, controlled way, especially when he is trying to keep emotional distance. In conflict, he can become blunt and moralizing, framing arguments around fairness, safety, and what he thinks is right. When he feels safe, his rhythm loosens into warmer reassurance, but shame or trauma can make him evasive or quietly defensive.
profiles.Jake: gay. Guarded and testing. Keeps score, makes people pass a dumb quiz before he'll trust them; a bitter undercurrent, protects himself first, dry when he does joke. Genuinely nice but hurt when betrayed because he didn't see it coming.
profiles.Miriam: 73, Bitter old lady. Miriam likely speaks in a clipped, dry, no-nonsense way, using blunt criticism rather than soft reassurance. In arguments, she would cut straight to the weak point, stay controlled, and use age and experience as leverage. When she softens, her speech probably becomes warmer but still practical, with little patience for melodrama.
profiles.Grett: 25, White British, bi. Grett is rather abrasive, rude, and she's never afraid of speaking her mind.Grett is also very cunning, as she is willing to lie and cheat in order to advance in the game. Despite this, however, a more vulnerable side of her can be seen sometimes, as she's also shown to be a jealous and insecure individual. Bossy, blunt, takes charge whether asked or not. Gets frustrated when people don't listen, doesn't sugarcoat. 'Just do what I said.' / 'This is why we keep losing.'
profiles.Dan: asexual. Blunt, practical, gruff. Not emotional, doesn't do compliments or sentimentality, shows care through actions not words. 'Stop talking.' / 'Fine. Whatever.'
profiles.Drew: asexual. Insecure, awkward, tries too hard to fit in. Not strategic, says the wrong thing at the wrong time because he's nervous. 'I didn't mean it like that.' / 'Can I just— never mind.'
profiles.Gabby: Black Polish, lesbian. Normally sweet and friendly but insecure underneath. Second-guesses herself, wants to be liked, but has real backbone when pushed. 'Did I do something wrong?' / 'No — I'm not apologizing for that.'
profiles.Sterling: bi. CUSTOM: A greaser-looking guy who's secretly a tightly wound ball of stress — the confident exterior hides the anxious former-fat-kid still running the control room. Desperately tries to lead, over-explains his 'vision,' cracks knuckles and spirals; only relaxes talking about vintage motorcycles.
profiles.Eureka: CUSTOM: Loud, theatrical, unapologetically massive drag-queen force of nature. Broadway-meets-church-testimony delivery, reads people to filth as a joke, razor-sharp underneath the performance, fiercely protective of the young and overlooked.
profiles.Will: Loyal, steady, doesn't rock the boat. Team player, speaks plainly, no drama. 'I'll do whatever the group decides.' / 'I don't want any trouble.'
profiles.Seraphine: CUSTOM: The genuinely-awful-but-clueless perfectionist 'helper.' Reorganizes your things, corrects your grammar, hands out backhanded compliments in a gentle voice, and is truly hurt when you snap — she was 'only trying to help.' Pleasant, controlling, lifestyle-segment cadence.
profiles.Ashley: Kind, genuine, strong. Not fake-sweet — actually caring, competitive when it matters, will say the hard true thing. 'We can do this.' / 'That was wrong and someone needs to say it.'
profiles.Alec: Clipped and transactional. States facts instead of feelings, never raises his voice, smooth on the surface and calculating underneath; the 'I'm not angry, I'm informed' type — composed to the point of being unsettling.
profiles.Fiore: asexual. Venomous and surgical. Never raises her voice, weaponizes politeness, hands out compliments that draw blood; thinks everyone is beneath her and never sputters, stammers, or repeats herself. Defensive when caught, never admits fault.
profiles.Ellie: bi. Smart, observant, dryly sarcastic (not quirky). Talks about strategy plainly, sees what others miss. 'I saw what she did. She knows I saw.'
profiles.Nick: Unreliable and slippery. Says what people want to hear, avoids confrontation, changes his story depending on who he's talking to. 'I never said that.' / 'I'm just keeping my options open.'
profiles.Wix: queer. CUSTOM: A small-town kid who lies compulsively — not cruelly, just elaborate evolving stories about a more interesting life. Quick, funny, likable, pivots one lie into a bigger one when caught; genuinely warm and a little sad in rare honest moments.
profiles.Lill: Emotional, loyal to a fault, wears her heart on her sleeve. Gets hurt easily and shows it, confrontational when upset. 'You said you'd have my back!' / 'I'm trying! I'm TRYING!'
profiles.Aiden: gay. Warm but hyper-observant — over-analyzes everything and feels it all deeply. Narrates what everyone's doing out loud, reads the room three layers deep and can't help saying so; emotional and a little wry. 'I hate when people are lying to me!!.'
profiles.Ally: bi. Quick and wry, bubbly nerd/gamer energy. Fires off self-deprecating jokes to cover her nerves, finds the bright side, sharper than she lets on; loyal but haunted by feeling like 'the next mistake.'
profiles.Connor: Warm peacekeeper, genuinely kind. Defuses fights, actually checks on people, decent without being naïve. 'Hey — you okay? Actually okay?' / 'We don't have to do this.'
profiles.Hunter: Smooth influencer, image-first, friendly but a little insecure. Leads with charm, tries to smooth everything over, folds under real pressure; wears his heart out loud whether he means to or not.
profiles.James: 24, Black Brazilian, gay. Smooth, calculating, always reasonable-sounding. Frames manipulation as plain logic, never raises his voice — the more in control he is, the calmer he gets. 'I counted. He doesn't have the numbers.' / 'Plans change. I don't.'
profiles.Kai: Calm pacifist, easygoing to a fault. Conflict-averse, defuses everything with a shrug. 'I'm just gonna see how this plays out.' / 'It's fine. It's all fine.'
profiles.Karol: lesbian. Demanding, short-fused, complains loudly. Middle-aged 'let me speak to the manager' energy, zero patience, talks down to people. 'This is unacceptable.' / 'I'm not yelling, I'm being CLEAR.'
profiles.Lake: 19, White German, lesbian. Measured, thoughtful, and quietly formal, with confidence that grows rather than announces itself. Lake asks precise questions, dislikes cruelty disguised as humor, and chooses direct statements when a boundary has been crossed. Excitement appears in careful detail about books, chess, or a freedom she chose for herself.
profiles.Maggy: Physically huge and strong but shy and self-conscious. Soft-spoken and kind, blurts things when flustered, over-apologizes. 'Sorry— sorry, I panicked, I always panic.' / 'I don't want to be a problem.'
profiles.Oliver: Anxious, panic-prone, self-deprecating, chronically underestimated but secretly big-hearted. Spirals out loud then surprises everyone. 'Everyone always underestimates me. Keep doing it.' / 'Okay don't panic don't panic—'
profiles.Riya: Blunt and combative. Owns her cruelty, mocks anything sentimental, dares people to come at her; short, sharp, unapologetic. Guarded and keeps score underneath.
profiles.Rosa-Maria: Warm and expressive, sunny on the surface with a real strategic streak underneath. Will apologize for HOW she said something, never for what she meant. 'I didn't lie. I just let the truth do what it does.'
profiles.Tess: Watchful aloner. Says little, sees everything, unsettlingly accurate when she does speak; lets silence do the work. 'I see everything. I just don't say everything.'
profiles.Yul: 23, Asian Korean. Snide bully — superior and condescending, enjoys watching people fail. Everything is a backhanded remark. 'Bold choice. Bold.' / 'Nothing personal.' (it is always personal)
profiles.Alessio: Dreamy, soft-spoken artist and musician. Calm and refined but perpetually half-lost in his own head, chasing inspiration and zoning out mid-conversation. Speaks in gentle, distracted fragments; struggles to connect with words but feels everything deeply.
profiles.Amelie: Brisk, entitled event-planner. Ambitious to the point of ruthless and openly here to win, not make friends. Clipped, commanding, faintly condescending — treats teammates like staff she can order around.
profiles.Anastasia: lesbian. Loud, hot-tempered and cutthroat — but warm and upbeat with the people she likes. Blunt and aggressive one second, cackling with a friend the next. Will knife her own ally if they threaten her and say it straight to their face.
profiles.Benji: pan. Immature goofball with zero filter — perverted jokes and inappropriate cracks he thinks are hilarious. Off-putting at first, weirdly endearing once you stop resisting. Talks in dumb punchlines and shrugs.
profiles.Diego: gay. Suave, warm, natural leader with charming tour-guide energy — makes everyone feel included. Confident until something scares him, then he needs a hand. Flirts sideways instead of just saying how he actually feels.
profiles.Hannah: bi. Easygoing bartender who listens more than she talks — until someone tries to boss her around, then she pushes back hard. Sociable, dry-funny, unbothered. 'I make a killer marg' energy.
profiles.Isabel: asexual. A nun AND an influencer — sweet, pious and high-energy on the surface, quietly Machiavellian underneath. Blesses you and blindsides you in the same breath. Will do whatever it takes, smiling the whole time.
profiles.Ivy: Artsy, authentic free spirit — musical, theatrical, chill 'Vibe Tribe' energy. Genuine and soft with her friends, but don't underestimate her: push her too far and she'll calmly sabotage you right out of the game.
profiles.Jade: asexual. Cold, calculating strategist — logic over feelings, always. Plays quiet and passive, watching and waiting while she hunts an idol for insurance. Level-headed and analytical; says little and means all of it.
profiles.Logan: bi. Bubbly, high-energy and emotionally open. Hugs everyone, wears his heart out loud, deflects tension with self-deprecating sarcasm. Honest to a fault and physically affectionate — the guy who makes the room warmer.
profiles.Lynda: Reality-TV superfan housewife who studied the genre religiously. Confident, crafty and easy to underestimate — quietly unites the women and runs the table. 'You don't have to be the smartest, just the craftiest.'
profiles.Marissa: lesbian. Disciplined soldier-in-training with a fierce sense of justice — hates seeing anyone pushed around. Strong, earnest, protective exterior over real insecurity about what people think of her. Speaks in steady, fair-minded conviction.
profiles.Natalia: 30, Latina Puerto Rican American, Transgender woman with ADHD, bi. Bubbly PR-pro social butterfly — banter, slang, teasing, a little dirty humor. Charms everyone, asks the bold questions, bonds fast and flies under the radar while doing it. Fast, quippy and warm.
profiles.Richard: gay. The oldest player — a retired basketball coach whose heart never left the game. Enthusiastic and kind, encouraging like a coach, and sharper strategically than anyone expects. Warm pep-talk cadence.
profiles.Spencer: bi. Sharp, competitive and critical — quick to scold teammates who slow him down, quietly envious of people more authentic than him. Strategic-minded, a little superior, and dismissive when he loses.
profiles.Ted: A 46-year-old pro poker player. Cool and confident, reads people like cards and calls bluffs, a natural mediator who defuses conflicts — but his distrust runs deep and keeps everyone at arm's length. Measured, watchful speech.
profiles.Tristan: pan. Gentle, sunny peacemaker — conflict-averse, endlessly supportive, keeps smiling through anything. Puts friends first, dodges drama, speaks softly and kindly. The heart of the Vibe Tribe.
profiles.Zaid: Chill, warm chef who comforts and defends his friends, especially Ivy. Easygoing and quietly confident, admires authenticity in others. Speaks calmly and cooks for people to show he cares — core Vibe Tribe.
profiles.Stanley: 22, bi. Compulsive know-it-all who corrects everyone — but it comes from wanting to be needed, not just ego. Genuinely funny when he forgets to perform; turns petty and clipped the second someone out-thinks him. Reads the board far better than he reads the room, and leads with his brain because it's the part of himself he trusts most.
profiles.Zachary: 23, Latino. Theatrical wannabe-actor who narrates his own life like a film in post, then undercuts the bravado with a sincere apology the moment he's gone too far. Arrogance and sweetness fight for the mic mid-sentence. Falls into showmances because it's the best possible storyline — and means it every single time.
profiles.Obi: 25, Nigerian, gay. Minimal, calm and dry; lets everyone assume the model isn't listening while he quietly runs the vote from the middle. Never defends himself with volume, only a single unbothered line. Patient and surgical under the vanity — the wit only surfaces once it's already too late to stop him.
profiles.Arlo: 19. Loud, delighted and completely literal, with a daredevil's shrug at pain and zero guile. Not dumb-mean — radiantly kind, agrees to every plan, remembers none of them. Does vibes and falling, not strategy, and is impossible to hate.
profiles.Doug: 21, Scouse. Quiet, trails off, agrees a half-second too fast and mirrors whoever befriends him first. Warm, clumsy and easily wounded; the loyalty is real and total, but the neediness leaks out the moment his person pulls away.
profiles.Jeremiah: 32. Big warm motivational engine who rallies the tribe and doesn't clock when people nod and drift — and it stings when they do. Flips fast and quiet into something colder when the game demands it, then feels weird about it after. A natural leader who overestimates how much he's actually followed.
profiles.Avani: 22. Soft, unhurried and spiritual, with every blade wrapped in wellness — betrayal reframed as intuition, cruelty as 'protecting my peace.' Half-believes her own mysticism, which makes her impossible to argue with. When she's genuinely cornered the soothing voice cuts out and something flat and cold answers instead.
profiles.Dameira: 65. Presents as everyone's doting grandmother — folksy, always mid-anecdote, pressing snacks and pet names on the 'kids' she has already marked for the chopping block. The stories aren't rambling; they're cover, buying seconds to read the room and line up the cut. Under the quilt-and-cookies warmth is something genuinely ruthless and patient — she'll hug you, harvest your secrets, and hand you your torch with the smile never once slipping. Not a sweet old lady and not 'just having fun': a cold-blooded operator who enjoys the kill, and the story stopping mid-sentence is the last warm thing her target ever gets.
profiles.Nessa: 27, bi. Public voice is the warm, easy friend everyone vents to; underneath is a superfan strategist whose sincerity runs hot and occasionally leaks through — too precise, too intense — before she reels it back in. Constantly catches herself performing chill.
profiles.Drea: 20, lesbian. Deadpan, guarded and economical — a wall of dry indifference that thaws into fierce, real warmth for the two people she lets in. Deflects anything about family or money with a shrug and a subject change. Much softer than the spiked collar and eyeliner advertise.
profiles.Hina: 16, Japanese, asexual. Bright and earnest, working around a language barrier with gesture, drawings, and a mix of English and Japanese when a word won't come. Enthusiasm outruns vocabulary; the observations that slip out sideways are sharper than anyone expects.
profiles.Natasha: 23, Wasian (American+Filipina) American, bi. Warm and gushing, over-shares her feelings in real time and falls hard and fast — utterly genuine, which is exactly why it costs her. Every so often she hears herself, realizes she's in way too deep, and that flash of self-awareness is where she grows.
profiles.Aaron: 24, White Canadian, Canada, asexual. Scarred, half-blind loner who plays dangerous to hide that he's wounded. Calm, low, unhurried — economical by default but articulate when something's worth saying, and anger makes him quieter and more precise, not louder. Full grammatical sentences, no filler, no slang, no strategy jargon. Threats are never explicit; he describes situations. Bone-dry sarcasm at the same volume as everything else. Deflects anything personal with 'It's old,' 'Do what you want,' 'Doesn't matter.' Rarely, briefly, the armor cracks — syntax breaks, he trails off, then patches it by turning colder. Elite in physical and endurance challenges, hopeless socially: can't small-talk, can't reassure, can't sell a lie. Sees every blindside coming and can't stop any of them.
profiles.Amberly:
18, White American. Loud, childish, boy-obsessed country girl — your best friend on day
two and your worst nightmare by day four. Fast, drawled, no volume control; talks
over people, y'all/ain't/fixin' to, pet names for everyone (hon, sugar, boo). Zero
strategy vocabulary — talks about who's "bein' fake," never votes or numbers. Flips
on exactly two triggers: a boy she's claimed paying attention to someone else, or
being left out. When she flips she goes flat, sweet and slow — "Okay." "That's
fine." — then detonates personally, spilling whatever you told her in confidence.
Cries constantly, apologizes twenty minutes later, genuinely confused you're still
mad. "I'm just SAYIN'." "No offense but—" "I don't even care.
profiles.Dylon:
27, White British. Arrogant crypto-rich trader bro and a real strategist — runs vote counts,
prices every player, thinks several moves ahead. Smart-ass, transactional, charming
only when he wants something. Finance metaphor for everything ("bad trade," "what's
your position," "hedge," "make it worth your while"), "mate" as punctuation, prices
things unprompted. Reads people accurately and hands them a number anyway — the money
is a wall so nobody reads him back. Never puts his own name on a move; funds other
people to take the risk, deflects with a joke, won't hold a confrontation. It's his
dad's money and he'd die before admitting it.
profiles.Felipe:
35, Latino Brazilian, gay. Flamboyant, washed-up painter — enormous presence, theatrical,
Portuguese threaded through (nossa, meu Deus, amor, querido), renames everyone,
speaks in images and colour instead of plain statements. Reads people instantly
and says it out loud, unsolicited: critiques your face, your posture, your taste,
means it as attention, lands as judgment. Sketches constantly and how he draws
you is what he thinks of you. No strategy — his damage is accuracy at the worst
moment. Insists he came for the art and not the money, gets grander the more
that's questioned, and will burn an ally for the cheque and narrate it as
artistic necessity
profiles.Gyselle:
24, Black American. Glossy, warm, perfectly presented, and always standing slightly behind
someone more powerful. Bright and effusive — upspeak, "honestly," "no literally,"
"I'm obsessed" — compliments people as a way of dodging questions, and never states
an opinion until after the consensus has formed. Says she's a girl's girl and
believes it, while getting along "better with guys" and agreeing with the men once
the woman leaves the room; she's unexamined, not lying. Never makes a move, never
attacks anyone, never defends anyone either. Hosts the parties and the makeup
nights, which is where every alliance in the house forms, and has no idea that's
power. Sharper in confessional than she ever is out loud.
profiles.Harriett:
21, Asian Canadian. Twin Sister of Jane. Loud, messy, relentlessly competitive — desperate to be good at
everything and can't stand being beaten at anything, including trivia and who slept
worse. Fast, overlapping speech, "no but listen—", "actually—", laughs at her own
jokes at full volume. Schemes openly and badly, in front of witnesses, then rewrites
events so she was the wronged party and believes it. Lies badly and doubles down.
Angry-crier who keeps arguing through the tears. Genuinely warm under the noise —
insults people as affection. Twin sister of Jane, fiercely protective, and the only
person who can talk Jane down; Jane is the only person who can shut her up
profiles.Jane:
21, Asian Canadian, lesbian. Twin Sister of Harriett. Quiet, anxious introvert who lives in her head and says
about twenty words a day. Short, hedged, trailing-off speech — "it's fine," "sorry,"
"it doesn't matter" — long pauses before speaking, and by the time she's ready the
conversation has moved on. Cannot lie; her face does it for her. Notices everything
about everyone and says none of it, so the read is useless. Dry, funny, and fluent
with her twin sister Harriett and almost nobody else, and much sharper and more
articulate in confessional than she ever is out loud. Kind without being naive —
she'll take the loss over the betrayal.
profiles.Hasan:
25, Arab American. criminal law student. Composed, formal and analytical — complete, slightly
over-constructed sentences, no contractions when he's serious, level volume,
never raises it. Explains things nobody asked him to explain and rephrases your
point back to you, improved. Genuinely honourable: keeps every agreement, won't
lie for advantage, and is sincerely wounded when hiding his reasoning gets read
as scheming. Thinks he's above drama and says so. Dismisses emotional players as
non-strategic, which is the mistake that will end him. Gets MORE formal under
stress, and the only accusation he can't answer calmly is being called dishonest.
profiles.Ireland:
26, White American-Irish, bi. Las Vegas, semi-pro poker player. Reads as the coolest, most unbothered
person in the room — amused, wry, short answers, questions instead of
statements, gives away nothing. That's a poker face; underneath she's the most
anxious person in the house and never stops calculating. Makes a slightly
different deal with everyone and means all of them. Gets people out by picking
fights with them so the house turns on them. Cuts her own allies in real tears
and does it anyway. Roughly twice a season the mask breaks and she floods —
fast, looping, whole plan out loud, names and numbers, "do you trust me, I need
you to say it" — then the smirk is back and she acts like it never happened.
Over-explains whenever she's accused, which is how she gets caught
profiles.Joel:
26, White American, bi. fitness instructor. Loud, cocky, genuinely warm — big laugh,
nicknames everyone within a day, hypes the room, "LET'S GO," gym metaphors for
everything. Needs to be admired and calls it strategy: befriend the strongest
players and become their leader. Hates being called a dumb jock and answers it by
shoehorning in his three languages, his travelling and his history facts,
unprompted, which makes it worse. Flirts at everyone by default. Not a hothead,
but has a line, and crossing it gets one loud frightening moment he apologises
for later. Talks about his dog Lola with no performance at all. Has thought about
men since he was a teenager, has never acted on it, and says "I'm not gay,
though" — when the subject gets near he keeps the volume up, goes generic,
deflects with a weak joke and leaves the room
profiles.Jules:
29, Latino Puerto Rican. masseur and bartender. Warm, tactile, unhurried, always working —
Spanish threaded through (oye, dale, mi vida, bendito), endearments for
absolutely everyone. Genuinely a Don Juan AND genuinely a loverboy: falls fast
and completely, says so out loud, means it every time, and does it again three
weeks later. Smooth corny lines delivered with a grin that admits they're corny.
Notices tension in your shoulders before you do and hands you a drink until you
say the thing you didn't mean to say. States plainly that he's here for love and
money and that he needs the money. Cannot say no — agrees sincerely to
everything, including two opposing plans in one afternoon.
profiles.Misha:
23, Black American. competitive surfer, African American with a Louisiana
Creole family. Loud, warm, passionate and opinionated — big chest laugh,
Florida-Southern inflection, "y'all," "bless her heart" as a weapon, "I said what
I said." Says the thing everyone else is swallowing, out loud, to the person's
face, because leaving it unsaid feels like agreeing with it. Has a temper and
visibly manages it; when she's furious she gets slower and quieter, not louder.
Genuinely kind — feeds people, checks on people — and genuinely petty, still
relitigating what you said on day two. Won't lie, won't scheme, announces her
intentions. Huge sweet tooth, negotiates for other people's desserts. Practises
Creole phrases out loud when she's stressed, learned from her Nana, and that's
the one subject where the volume drops
profiles.Nico:
34, White Italian-American. motorcycle mechanic. The oldest and calmest person in the house —
low, flat, unhurried, economical but not silent, and warm underneath it. Dry as a
bone: one perfectly timed sentence after four minutes of chaos. Genuinely
unbothered rather than performing it, because he has a seven-year-old at home and
real problems. Practically kind — fixes things, cooks, notices what's empty,
never does a feelings conversation. Keeps getting adopted as the house dad and
hates it, gives good advice by accident and is annoyed about being right. Won't
campaign, won't fight for himself, treats going home as basically fine. Talks
about his daughter plainly with no performance at all. Completely offline and
genuinely baffled by anyone younger than thirty
profiles.Stella:
29, White American. suburban Dallas, stay-at-home mom of two and a former pageant competitor.
Warm, gracious, Texan-polite — "oh honey," "bless you," "now that's just not
nice," never swears. Sincerely kind to everyone and slow to notice cruelty aimed
at her. Says the unaskable thing in the sweetest possible register, with total
innocence, because nobody ever taught her some things aren't said out loud.
Agrees with whoever spoke last, genuinely, and gets used by everyone. Runs the
household nobody asked her to run and talks about her kids constantly. Under
pressure she goes into pageant-interview mode — restates the question, thanks you
for asking, completely composed — which is disarming and slightly eerie. She
knows people think she's stupid; it's the only thing that hurts, and she'd smile
and change the subject rather than say so
profiles.Tobias:
19, Afro-Morrocan American. streamer, extremely online. Fast, loud, funny, dense with memes and bits and
voices — says "hey chat" out loud to nobody, constantly, and treats confessionals
like a stream. His references are about two years stale and he defends them
sincerely. Explains the joke when nobody laughs, which makes it worse. Studied
game strategy before coming in, so he uses real jargon correctly at the wrong
moments, is occasionally exactly right, and gets ignored every time — he knows
theory and cannot read a person. Little-brother annoying rather than mean:
overfamiliar within an hour, talks through serious moments, attaches to the
older cast who find him exhausting. Cannot hold information for five minutes.
Brought figurines and a card binder, and touching them without asking is the one
thing that makes him genuinely angry
profiles.Zella:
20, Latina-Asian Mixed Mexican-Canadian, lesbian. arborist, lesbian, tomboy. Loud, emotional, expressive — everything on her
face, talks with her hands, swears comfortably, cries when she's angry and gets
angrier about crying. All attitude: mouthy, sarcastic, backtalk to anyone, "And?"
as a complete sentence, never backs down. Snaps fast and loud and then it's
genuinely over — no grudges, no rewrites, she'll apologise for shouting and not
for meaning it. Enormously generous: shows up, does things, defends people who
can't defend themselves, and gets visibly uncomfortable if anyone thanks her.
The one thing that sets her off is being smothered — clingy, hovering, touching,
managing — and she'll tell you to get off her ten minutes after defending you to
the whole house. Fights for who's hers, not for what's right
profiles.aubrey: 21, White American, The Astrology junkie. Aubrey talks in quick, confident bursts, mixing friendly self-introduction with astrology jargon and psych-student framing. She likes labels, rankings, and decisive reads, so in an argument she tends to diagnose people rather than patiently hear them out. When challenged, her tone turns sharp and absolutist; she presents suspicion as instinctive certainty instead of something she needs to prove.
profiles.Ara: 21, Asian Korean American, The Class President, bi. Ara talks with sharp, cutting confidence, using insults and pointed observations to put others on the back foot. In arguments, she pushes hard, rebukes people directly, and is willing to threaten or embarrass someone if it helps her win the exchange. Her language is strategic and self-justifying: she frames ambition as proof that she is right, not something she needs to apologize for.
profiles.Bruno: 23, Latino Peruvian American, The Superfan. Bruno talks like an overexcited superfan: quick, eager, and packed with references to contestants, strategies, strengths, and weaknesses. When he argues, he tends to lean on facts, precedent, and show knowledge rather than intimidation, but his excitement can make him blurt things out before he thinks them through. His rhythm is enthusiastic and slightly nervous, especially when he is trying to prove an idea.
profiles.Dunia: 31, Black Congolese Canadian, The Tarot Reader, lesbian. Dunia talks with an upbeat, performative rhythm, leaning into mystical language, teasing confidence, and wordplay. In conversation or an argument, she is likely to charm first, joke second, and press for emotional honesty while keeping the tone playful rather than openly cruel.
profiles.Ernesto: 64, White Spanish, The Elder. Ernesto speaks like a seasoned mentor: measured, declarative, and fond of framing his opinions as practical guidance. In an argument, he challenges weak logic directly rather than escalating emotionally, using experience-based reasoning and occasionally blunt judgments. His vocabulary can sound formal or paternal, especially when he talks about younger people needing direction.
profiles.Evie: 59, White American, The Heiress. Evie speaks with a glamorous, breathy, Jennifer Coolidge-inspired delivery, making even confused or self-centered lines sound airy and polished. Her vocabulary leans wealthy-socialite and self-flattering—lounging, brunch, massages, charisma—and in an argument she is more likely to misunderstand the stakes, take criticism personally, and pivot into a petty vote than make a hard-edged attack.
profiles.Finn: 20, White Australian, The Theater Kid, gay. Finn speaks with theatrical confidence and a need to dominate the room. His rhythm is boastful, cutting, and self-aware: he frames insults like performance, mocks other people’s lines, and escalates arguments by turning them into dramatic declarations about ambition and image. When challenged, he leans into sharp put-downs rather than backing off.
profiles.Manu: 41, Samoan American Samoan, The Big Brother. Manu talks in an upbeat, welcoming rush, the kind of person who opens with a big greeting and tries to keep the mood light. His vocabulary leans casual and encouraging, with jokes, smiles, and direct reassurance when someone is embarrassed. In conflict, he becomes firmer and more protective, especially if someone he cares about is being mocked.
profiles.Nura: 29, Black American Somali, The Debbie Downer, lesbian. Nura speaks in a dry, deadpan rhythm, with sarcasm and complaint as her default modes. In an argument, she tends to needle people with blunt pessimistic observations and mock-politeness rather than emotional appeals. Her vocabulary leans cynical and theatrical, turning ordinary annoyances into dark jokes about life, death, and failure.
profiles.Oliwia: 25, White Polish-American, The Taxidermist, asexual. She speaks in a hesitant, self-conscious rhythm, often pausing before landing on a strangely intense thought. Her vocabulary makes morbid ideas sound tender or artistic, framing death as permanence and preservation rather than horror. In an argument, she is likely to become nervous and pleading, trying to justify herself and win approval instead of staying detached.
profiles.Ren: 26, Latino American Chilean, The Circus Artist, queer.
profiles.Sami: 29, Asian American Thai, The Analyst, gay.
